channel.title: SHTG Daily Digest — Weiss Lab
channel.description: Daily research digest on severe hypertriglyceridemia, ANGPTL3, ANGPTL4, APOC3, and lipoprotein lipase. Auto-generated from PubMed for Ethan Weiss.
channel.itunes:author: Ethan Weiss

item.title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 26, 2026
item.description: A landmark Circulation imaging trial finds that olezarsen's dramatic triglyceride lowering does not translate into coronary plaque regression at 12 months—raising fundamental questions about TG-lowering as an atherosclerosis therapy just as the 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline reframes how we should think about hypertriglyceridemia, and with Ionis's PDUFA date for the SHTG indication just five weeks away.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 26, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 22, 2026
item.description: A landmark ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline dropped this week alongside a pivotal Circulation imaging trial showing olezarsen's dramatic triglyceride reduction does not translate into coronary plaque regression — a sobering finding that reframes what APOC3 inhibition can and cannot achieve at 12 months; on the industry side, the two biggest near-term catalysts remain Ionis' June 30 PDUFA date for olezarsen in sHTG and Arrowhead's expected EU approval of REDEMPLO, both just outside this cycle's lookback window but essential context.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 22, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 19, 2026
item.description: A landmark Circulation imaging trial shows olezarsen dramatically lowers triglycerides but does not shrink coronary plaque, while two new meta-analyses confirm robust TG and pancreatitis benefits across the ApoC-III inhibitor class, and on the industry side both Arrowhead and Ionis are sprinting toward a mid-2026 collision in the sHTG market.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 19, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 15, 2026
item.description: A quiet top-tier journal week — no NEJM/Lancet/JAMA hits, but the next tier delivered three substantial APOC3-inhibitor meta-analyses (olezarsen, plozasiran, and the full ApoC-III class) all landing the same message: large triglyceride drops and a dramatic ~80% cut in acute pancreatitis risk, plus a new HNF4A–SPP2–LPL axis that could expand the SHTG target list; the industry side was equally subdued, dominated by Madrigal's $1B-biobucks pickup of an Arrowhead RNAi MASH asset and the run-up to Ionis' Tryngolza sHTG PDUFA at the end of June.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 15, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 12, 2026
item.description: A thin top-tier journal week pushed Part A to the next-best tier, where ApoC-III inhibitors keep stacking up favorable meta-analytic evidence and a new HNF4A–SPP2–LPL axis hints at fresh small-molecule entry points; the industry side is also quiet — the dominant story over the past seven days remains the run-up to the late-June Tryngolza sHTG PDUFA, with no major company-specific lipid news from the allowed outlets.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 12, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Saturday May 9, 2026
item.description: No top-tier journal acromegaly-style hits this cycle, but the broader lipid literature delivered two useful APOC3-inhibitor / olezarsen meta-analyses and a timely RNAi-for-lipid-disorders review; Part B was a quiet news week for Arrowhead, Alnylam, and Ionis specifically, with the Tryngolza severe-hypertriglyceridemia FDA decision (due by June 30) the dominant near-term catalyst.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Saturday May 9, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 8, 2026
item.description: No top-tier journal hits surfaced this week — showing the next-best tier — but the haul is unusually substantive: the first randomized evidence that an APOC3 siRNA (plozasiran) prevents recurrent pancreatitis in very severe hypertriglyceridemia, a major Hegele review repositioning ANGPTL3 as a remnant-cholesterol target, and new human data linking ANGPTL3/4/8 complexes to heart failure outcomes.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 8, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 5, 2026
item.description: A landmark 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline, strong new RCT data for plozasiran in pancreatitis prevention, and a phase II win for chiglitazar in MASLD-plus-hypertriglyceridemia headline a busy week — with the NEJM fielding letters on olezarsen and Nat Rev Cardiol weighing in on the road ahead for apoC-III inhibitors.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday May 5, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Monday May 4, 2026
item.description: This week's top-tier literature is anchored by the new 2026 ACC/AHA Dyslipidemia Guideline — the most comprehensive update to U.S. lipid management in eight years — alongside a cluster of NEJM correspondence debating the landmark olezarsen APOC3-targeting RCT and its implications for pancreatitis prevention in severe hypertriglyceridemia.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Monday May 4, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Sunday May 3, 2026
item.description: A thin but consequential week — the new 2026 ACC/AHA multisociety dyslipidemia guideline lands in Circulation with hypertriglyceridemia and Lp(a) carved out as first-class targets, and three NEJM correspondence pieces continue the post-publication debate over olezarsen's pancreatitis benefit in severe hypertriglyceridemia.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Sunday May 3, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Saturday May 2, 2026
item.description: A quiet week for new mechanistic and trial data, but two notable items: the 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline drops in Circulation (now formally folding hypertriglyceridemia into the same document as cholesterol), and three independent correspondence letters in NEJM probe the olezarsen pancreatitis-risk findings reported earlier this year by the TIMI group.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Saturday May 2, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 1, 2026
item.description: A thin original-research week, but two genuinely high-impact items: the new joint 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline (which now formally addresses hypertriglyceridemia and Lp(a) alongside LDL-C), and three published letters in NEJM debating the CORE-TIMI 72a/b olezarsen trial — including the Marston/Bergmark/Sabatine reply.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Friday May 1, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Thursday April 30, 2026
item.description: A thin but consequential week — the new 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline lands in *Circulation* and explicitly folds hypertriglyceridemia into the cholesterol-management framework, while *NEJM* publishes a correspondence cluster pressure-testing the pancreatitis-risk findings of the pivotal olezarsen (APOC3) trial.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Thursday April 30, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Wednesday April 29, 2026
item.description: A landmark week — the ACC/AHA released the first major U.S. dyslipidemia guideline since 2018, plozasiran's PALISADE post-hoc shows it prevents recurrent pancreatitis in very severe hypertriglyceridemia (and now has its first regulatory approval), and two new Nature Reviews Cardiology pieces frame the next phase for ApoC-III– and ANGPTL3-directed therapies.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Wednesday April 29, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday April 28, 2026
item.description: The long-awaited 2026 ACC/AHA Dyslipidemia Guideline drops today in *Circulation*, while concurrent evidence on plozasiran, ANGPTL3 inhibition, and ApoC-III blockade reinforces that RNA-based triglyceride therapies are reshaping the clinical landscape for SHTG and residual cardiovascular risk.
item.itunes:title: SHTG Digest — Tuesday April 28, 2026

item.title: SHTG Digest — Friday April 24, 2026
item.description: No top-tier journal hits this week. Second-tier highlights: plozasiran (APOC3 siRNA) cuts recurrent acute pancreatitis by 83% in FCS patients (PALISADE post-hoc); olezarsen meta-analysis confirms 48% TG reduction across 4 RCTs; ANGPTL3 inhibitor meta-analysis shows 73% remnant cholesterol reduction; two Nature Reviews Cardiology reviews on ANGPTL3 and ApoC-III implementation.
